phases.title: Cabin, before the walk

blocks.title: What this course does not teach
blocks.text: This course teaches the AFM walk-around route and the wording of each check. It does not teach judgement: what a normal shock-absorber compression looks like, how to drain and read a fuel sample, what grounds the aircraft. Have your instructor show you that, at the aircraft.

blocks.title: PRE-FLIGHT INSPECTION — CABIN, BEFORE THE WALK
blocks.source: AFM p. 4.04–4.05 (translated from the French original)

steps.do: Check full and free movement of the controls, then walk around the aircraft starting at the left side of the fuselage.
